name: mprisence-bridge
description: Provides rich web media player metadata from your browser to MPRIS

scripts.build:all: node build.mjs firefox && node build.mjs chromium
scripts.build:store: node build.mjs firefox --store && node build.mjs chromium --store
scripts.package:source: mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/mprisence-extension-source.zip && zip -r dist/mprisence-extension-source.zip src icons manifest.shared.json manifest.firefox.json manifest.chromium.json build.mjs package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.json README.md
